channel.title: Nandkishor Blogs — Superbike Riding Guides, Gear & Dubai Routes
channel.description: A superbike blog covering pre-ride checklists, gear reviews, Dubai riding routes, and rider stories — written from the saddle by Nandkishor Sharma (@nk.rider.eats).

item.title: The Pre-Ride Heat Checklist: Getting Your Superbike Ready for Dubai Summers
item.description: A practical pre-ride checklist for riding superbikes safely through Dubai and UAE heat — tyres, fluids, gear, timing and hydration.

item.title: Best Early-Morning Ride Routes Out of Dubai
item.description: Hatta, Al Qudra, Jebel Jais and the Dubai-Al Ain road — four early-morning superbike routes with fuel and food stops mapped in.

item.title: Riding a Superbike in the Rain: What Actually Changes
item.description: UAE-specific wet-weather riding advice — braking distance, visibility, flooded underpasses and the gear that actually works.

item.title: Chain, Sprocket & Brake Wear: A Simple Log Sheet
item.description: A simple, no-workshop-needed way to log chain, sprocket and brake wear before it becomes an expensive problem.

item.title: Two Years on Two Wheels: Riding Scotland's Roads (2015-2017)
item.description: Two years riding the Scottish Highlands — single-track roads, cold-weather gear, and lessons that carried over to riding in the UAE.

item.title: Race Day at Knockhill: My First Track Day in Scotland
item.description: A first track day at Knockhill Racing Circuit in Fife, Scotland — racing lines, braking markers, and what track riding actually teaches you.
